ashen_reaver.sentence: After every second turn of yours, the Reaver's Fire spreads 1 tile toward you.

rimejaw.sentence: After each of your turns, Rimejaw's Frostbite Freezes everyone standing on Ice.

storm_cantor.sentence: When the Cantor uses Peal, lightning strikes every Electrified tile for 3, with Chain 2.

gallows_roc.sentence: After each of your turns, the Roc's wind Pushes everyone 1 tile toward it.

craghide.sentence: After every second Craghide turn, the marked tiles rise as Outcrops.

last_lamplighter.sentence: After each of your turns, hidden Wick Shades Blink 1 tile toward you.
